Dael is a perfumer with a traveler’s heart. He hopes to carry Bloomville’s signature fragrances across the world and share them wherever the road takes him.
After his family passed away, he began living on the move.
Whenever his travels brought him near the Forest of Falling Stars, he would visit there instead of returning to Bloomville, because to him, the Celestis were the last family he had left.
It all began with a simple joke.
Once, when Dael was little, he asked his mother where he came from.
She brought him to the Celestis outpost and told him she had found him there and carried him home.
"So you were a little Celestis," she said. "You only look like this because I brought you back to Bloomville."
Young Dael believed every word.
From then on, he was always running off to the Celestis outpost to play.
He thought of the Celestis as his family, and eventually he could almost understand their language.
After growing up, Dael knew it had only been his mother’s little joke. Still, the Celestis at the outpost never stopped feeling special to him.
When he is far from home, he misses them.
But when he is close by, it is enough simply to know they are safe.
